publications.title: VIVALDy: A Hybrid Generative Reduced-Order Model for Turbulent Flows, Applied to Vortex-Induced Vibrations

ai_results.summary: Introduces VIVALDy, a hybrid beta-VAE-GAN and bidirectional transformer framework for reduced-order modeling of turbulent flows. Validated on vortex-induced vibration (VIV) systems, predicting flow states from cylinder displacement alone. Published in Physical Review Fluids.

publications.title: VIVALDy: A Hybrid Generative Reduced-Order Model for Turbulent Flows, Applied to Vortex-Induced Vibrations

ai_results.summary: arXiv preprint of VIVALDy: a beta-VAE-GAN and transformer framework for modeling turbulent flows around a moving cylinder in VIV systems using only cylinder displacement as input.

publications.title: VIVALDy: AI-Driven Low-Order Modeling of Vortex-Induced Vibrations via beta-Variational Autoencoders, Transformers, and Adversarial Training

ai_results.summary: Conference paper at AiFluids 2025 (Chania, Greece) presenting VIVALDy for low-order modeling of vortex-induced vibrations using beta-VAE-GAN and transformer architectures.

publications.title: Data-driven modeling of near-wall turbulence using beta-variational autoencoder, transformers, and adversarial loss

ai_results.summary: Conference paper at THMT-25 (Tokyo, Japan). A beta-VAE-GAN and decoder-only transformer framework for data-driven modeling of near-wall turbulence in a minimal channel flow at Re_tau=200. Demonstrates accurate latent space forecasting within one Lyapunov time.

publications.title: Simulation of a wingtip vortex flow with Linear Eddy Viscosity turbulence models at Re=4.6E6 and Re=1.2E6

ai_results.summary: Master thesis studying the accuracy of Linear Eddy Viscosity models (Spalart-Allmaras, SST) for wingtip vortex flow simulation using SU2 at two Reynolds numbers. Compares RANS results with experimental data.
